data_source: sort_data.csv (4 items: python, java, html, cpp → Tier 1 vs Tier 2)

segments.name: hook
segments.text: A massive system leak just exposed the raw intelligence files. The AI Tribunal is about to sort the most controversial programming languages into their true tiers.

segments.name: setup
segments.text: Four pieces of evidence are loaded into the scanner. Each one will be analyzed, classified, and routed to its tier. Let the tribunal begin.

segments.name: card_1
segments.text: First up, Python. The AI king. No contest. Massive adoption, clean syntax, and dominance in machine learning. The tribunal routes it straight to Tier One.

segments.name: card_2
segments.text: Next, Java enters the scanner. Verbose, heavy, enterprise-locked. The tribunal flags it as Tier Two. Solid but not elite.

segments.name: card_3
segments.text: Now, HTML slides in. The tribunal scans it and immediately triggers a warning. Not even a real programming language. Tier Two, no appeal.

segments.name: card_4
segments.text: Finally, C plus plus. Raw power, blazing speed, zero hand-holding. The tribunal confirms: Tier One. A true veteran of the code battlefield.

segments.name: winner
segments.text: All evidence has been processed. The sort is complete. Tier One takes the crown with Python and C plus plus leading the grid.

segments.name: outro
segments.text: Tribunal session ended. Data secured. Follow for the next system breach.
